asset_creation_rules: Use original English labels and generic authored shapes
Record units, origin, coordinate frames, assembly and custody connections
Keep handles, apertures, gripper contact zones and station safety envelopes explicit
Preserve source material facts as metadata, not guessed CAD
Separate visible conceptual geometry from collision/manipulation requirements
No source PDFs, screenshots, media, source code, model weights or CAD in export
Static previews cannot establish force/optical accuracy, robot reachability, safety or physical success
robot_readiness_gate: required raw data or fresh facility evidence
